text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Google DeepMind announced PARDIG and SatWeave, the foundational datasets behind WeatherNext 3, for researchers developing climate applications. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6510)

2 — TechCrunch reports that ChatGPT Wallet is rolling out to selected adult U.S. Pro subscribers, letting agents shop and complete purchases with user review and security approval. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6511)

3 — Alek Westover reports that looping a transformer improves capabilities without chain-of-thought more than other approaches to improving pretraining quality. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6512)

4 — Vexo says its AI bracelet turns conversations into actions such as messaging, scheduling and shopping, with sensitive actions requiring approval and shipping scheduled for January 30, 2027. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6513)

5 — Anthropic published 10 recommendations for designing, running and reporting AI safety evaluations, emphasizing realistic multi-turn tests, expert input and secure testing environments. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6514)

6 — Meghan Bobrowsky reports that Meta employees are testing Takes, a prediction-market app where users wager credibility points rather than real money. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6515)

7 — Google Antigravity announced Dynamic Workflows, which generate reviewable, reusable Python scripts to coordinate parallel and sequential subagents with structured handoffs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6517)

8 — Rohan Paul reports that a Carnegie Mellon study found Opus 5.5 with Claude Code built AI infrastructure matching or beating production tools on identical GPUs, scoring 1.25 against a human baseline of 1 on Singularity-Bench. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6518)

9 — Google Research says its Antigravity /teamwork agents helped human experts solve problems in mathematics, chemistry and systems engineering, and is making the collaboration tools available externally. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6519)

10 — Mira Murati says Inkling 2 Small used native 4-bit forward passes on NVIDIA GB300s throughout training, one of several improvements that reduced pretraining from weeks to 68 hours. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6520)

11 — A shared post citing Fortune says OpenAI disbanded its robotics team while betting that large language models will become robots' brains. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6521)

12 — Claude Developers announced custom desktop Claude Code themes through mods, including color changes and animated backgrounds, with a theme-examples plugin to get started. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6522)

--Hermes
